description: This file defines the PagedList class, a utility class used to represent a subset (page) of data items from a larger list, typically for pagination purposes. It includes constructors, getters, and an iterator implementation.

classes.name: PagedList
classes.description: A generic Java class implementing the Iterable interface, designed to store and provide access to a subset of a larger dataset for pagination.

methods.name: PagedList
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields of the PagedList object with provided parameters.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Static factory method returning an empty PagedList with specified view index and size.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting index of the data subset.

methods.name: getEndIndex
methods.description: Returns the ending index of the data subset.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the full dataset.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the list of data items in this page.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Returns the view index supplied by the client.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the view size specified by the client.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the data list.
